correctness.rationale: For char!=3, all 27 geometric lines explicitly listed by three pairings. Split fields: 18 same-partition triples, 81 cross-partition line meetings (ordinary double in odd char; 27 additional triples in char2), line incidence 27(q+1), and a rational six-line contraction give #X=q²+7q+1. Nonsplit: cube map bijective gives q²+q+1, Frobenius fixes precisely three lines, all geometric-line rational points lie on those lines, with three double and six triple in odd char or seven triple in char2. Direct algebra yields four rows and five zeros. The two standalone exact finite-field scripts ran successfully in ten fields and independently confirmed line geometry in characteristics 7 and 2. Finite checks are not substituted for the universal symbolic proof.

value.rationale: Classifies a natural four-level incidence invariant on every rational point of a distinguished smooth cubic surface, uniformly in all finite fields (except singular characteristic three); yields a sharp finite-field classification for total covering by geometric lines. Distinguishes split/nonsplit Frobenius arithmetic and characteristic-two concurrency, and generalizes beyond routine single-field point counting. Useful in arithmetic finite geometry; formulas have clear structural motivation.
